## About KitchenBay

KitchenBay (kitchenbay.co) is India's premium e-commerce destination for authentic handcrafted kitchenware, cookware, dining essentials, and traditional home décor.

### Business Information
- **Legal Name**: Kitchenbay Private Limited
- **Founded**: 2015
- **Location**: 19/A, Line Street, Attur, Salem (DT), Tamil Nadu — 636102, India
- **Email**: kitchenbaypvtltd@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://kitchenbay.co

### What We Sell
- **Kitchenware**: Cast iron cookware, triply cookware, soapstone cookware, kitchen storage, kitchen accessories
- **Dining**: Coffee & tea makers, trays & bowls, pitchers & cups, dining plates
- **Brass & Copper**: Brass cookware, copper cookware, brass dining & serving
- **Décor**: Lamps & diyas, pooja essentials

### Materials We Specialize In
- Cast Iron (pre-seasoned, naturally non-stick)
- Stainless Steel (premium grade)
- Soapstone (traditional slow cooking)
- Brass (timeless elegance, Ayurvedic benefits)
- Copper (water storage, health benefits)
- Bronze (traditional South Indian)

### Key Features
- 500+ happy deliveries across India
- 50+ artisans empowered
- Products reaching 28 states
- 200+ unique products
- 48-hour easy return policy
- Free shipping above Rs. 2000
- Secure payment via Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking)
- GST invoicing available

### Shipping & Returns
- Standard delivery: 5-7 business days
- Pan-India shipping to 20,000+ pincodes
- Free shipping on orders above Rs. 2000
- Cash on delivery available (up to Rs. 5,000)
- 48-hour return policy
- Free returns for damaged items
